objective: Users can access project management and system menus as global pages without a project selector while project business authorization remains scoped to the selected project.

requirements.statement: Project management and system routes must not initialize or display the project context selector.
acceptance: At /projects and /system/**, no desktop, standard-header, or mobile-drawer selector is rendered
A previously stored project selection remains available when returning to a project business route
counterexample: A system page invokes project initialization or renders a project selector

requirements.statement: The project management route must be visible without a current project only when the user has project:project:list in at least one accessible project.
acceptance: The no-project authorization route tree includes /projects for a user with project:project:list in one accessible project
The route tree excludes /projects for users with only other project permissions or no project-management permission
counterexample: A project:plan:list-only user receives /projects, or an authorized user loses it without a selected project

requirements.statement: Project business routes and APIs must retain project-context initialization and server-side X-Project-Id authorization.
acceptance: A project business route still initializes context and displays the selector
Project APIs still reject missing or forged project context
counterexample: A project API succeeds without valid X-Project-Id after the change

requirements.statement: When ccb.current_project_id is absent, authentication must restore an accessible project and its project-scoped authorization without removing the global authorization fallback.
acceptance: Login and session hydration select an accessible project through the existing project-context store
The resulting authorization snapshot contains project-level menus
No accessible project or a workbench failure leaves the user signed in with global menus
counterexample: A user with accessible projects only sees system settings after a missing local project ID
A workbench failure clears the user session

invariants: No JWT, public API, database, project data, or V202 migration changes
Existing stored project selection is not cleared
Project data scope and entity authorization remain server-enforced
constraints: No production access or sensitive configuration
Use existing Vue Router, Pinia, Element Plus, Spring and JdbcTemplate patterns
non_goals: Changing project membership or role data
Changing project APIs or HTTP header contract
Refactoring the route tree or shared UI components
Changing the V202 menu text migration

assumptions.text: project:project:list is the leaf permission for the /projects menu
assumptions.basis: user-confirmed design and existing project permission naming
assumptions.falsifier: menu catalog or focused test shows a different permission mapping

unknowns.question: Whether existing focused tests can represent an active membership in another project without a current project
unknowns.impact: May require expanding test fixtures but not the product requirement

decisions.question: What grants project management without a selected project

measurement_intents.observable: global-route initialization and selector visibility at desktop/mobile
no-project dynamic route tree for positive and negative permission cases
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: AuthService focused tests and local API probe

measurement_intents.observable: project route initialization and invalid-context API rejection
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: existing security tests, API probe, and browser verification

measurement_intents.observable: missing local project ID causes project-context initialization followed by a project authorization refresh
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: frontend build, focused store code inspection, and authenticated local browser verification
